title: rag.py eval over the 574 rows takes a third of today's time: the _self view holds each tested anchor's informative words once
goal: kbfacts.tested_matches reads each anchored tested question's informative-word set from its store view, computed once per view, instead of key_terms and st.own() lookups for every anchor on every pack, so python3 _tools/rag.py eval prints the same 574 passed and the same pack text for every row (rag.py eval --all before and after agree byte for byte) with under 2,000 _load_own calls over the run, where today's cProfile of the run shows 138,740 calls (1.26 s) and tested_matches at 1.87 s of 6.3 s (the tool-speed record: 0.79 s over 250 rows on 2026-09-28, 3.97 s over 574 on 2026-10-08); the tool-speed scenario's rag.py eval row is re-recorded (a free run) and kb/_self/tools.md says where a pack's time goes.

run: import cProfile,pstats,runpy,sys;sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");sys.argv=["_tools/rag.py","eval"];p=cProfile.Profile();p.enable();exec("try: runpy.run_path(sys.argv[0],run_name=\"__main__\")\nexcept SystemExit: pass");p.disable();n=sum(v[1] for k,v in pstats.Stats(p).stats.items() if k[2]=="_load_own");print("_load_own calls",n);sys.exit(0 if n<2000 else 1)
